keygen.title: Generating a master key
keygen.body: Run pnpm keygen in the project root, then add the printed line (VMUI_MASTER_KEY=...) to .env.local. Restart the dev server. Everything sensitive — credentials, SSH private keys — is sealed with AES-256-GCM using this key.

providers.title: Provider quick reference
providers.aws: IAM access key + secret. Recommend a dedicated user with EC2 + S3 + RDS + ELB + Route53 read/write.
providers.azure: Service principal — tenantId, clientId, clientSecret, subscriptionId. Contributor on the target subscription.
providers.gcp: Service-account JSON key. Compute, Storage, Cloud SQL, DNS roles. Pasted JSON is encrypted before disk.
providers.kvm: SSH host + key for the libvirt host. Vatra talks directly to libvirt via the chosen URI.

background.title: What runs in the background
background.body: A sync loop refreshes instances every minute. Schedules tick every 30 seconds. Audit logs older than 30 days are gzipped to disk and removed from the live table.
